subject: general
question: Who among the following personalities is an award-winning Bhojpuri folk singer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Malini Awasthi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Malini Awasthi** is an award-winning **Bhojpuri folk singer.**
 
• She performs **Thumri and Kajri songs** in addition to singing in** Bhojpuri, Awadhi, and Hindi**.
 
• In **2016,** the Indian government bestowed upon her the** civilian title **of Padma Shri.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhojpuri folk music **is a traditional music genre from the Bhojpuri-speaking regions of **Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, and Jharkhand.**
 
• **Ila Arun** is an **Indian actress and singer.**
 
 
• She is known for her work in **Rajasthani and folk music.**
 
 
 
• **Rabbi Shergill **is a singer and composer.
 
 
• He is known for his fusion of** Punjabi folk music** with rock and pop.
 
 
 
• **Papon** is a singer and composer.
 
 
• He is known for his work in **Assamese folk music**.
